articles.text: ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Qǐngwèn, cāntīng zài jǐlóu?
MR. ANDERSON: May I ask, on what floor is the dining room?
ATTENDANT: It's on the second floor.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Ou, wǒ zuò diàntī dào èrlóu. Xiàle diàntī wàng nǎbian zǒu?
MR. ANDERSON: Oh, I take the elevator to the second floor. When I get off, which way do I go?
FÚWÙYUÁN: Xiàle diàntī, wàng yòu zǒu, jiù shi cāntīng.
ATTENDANT: When you get off the elevator, go to the right, and that's the dining room.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Qǐngwèn, nǐmen zhèli yǒu meiyou lǐfàde dìfang?
MR. ANDERSON: May I ask, is there a place to get a haircut here?
FÚWÙYUÁN: Yǒu. Cóng zhèli wàng zuǒ zǒu. Xià lóu, jiù kànjian le.
ATTENDANT: Yes. From here go to the left. Go downstairs, and then you'll see it.
ĀNDÉSĒN XIĀNSHENG: Xǐshǒujiān zài shénme dìfang?
MR. ANDERSON: Where is the washroom?
FÚWÙYUÁN: Zài nàli. Wàng lǐ zǒu, zài yòubian.
ATTENDANT: It's over there. Go all the way in, and it's on the right.
